Frequently asked questions

Answers for shoppers, sellers and partners.

When will Shopyos be available?

We are preparing for launch. Join the waitlist to receive early-access and availability updates.

What payment methods will be supported?

Shopyos is being designed for Ghana’s payment context, including mobile money and card-based payments where available.

How will delivery work?

The platform is designed to support local and inter-regional fulfilment, with order and delivery-status updates for supported deliveries.

Can I become a seller?

Yes. Sellers will be able to register a business, create a store profile, manage products and handle orders from one place.

How will returns or support work?

Support and order-history tools are planned to help customers get help with an order. Specific return policies will be shared at launch.

Will Shopyos be secure?

Trust features such as seller verification, reviews, payment safeguards and customer support are central to the platform design.

Shopyos is building a local commerce marketplace for buyers and sellers across Ghana.
